items.title: וין: תלויות + פאטץ' 1.5 (ניסיון 3)
items.instruction: 2rb5e7k8lc: run timeout=900 powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "echo PYVER; python --version 2>&1; echo STEP_NUMPY; python -m pip install -q --no-input numpy 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 1; python -c 'import numpy; print(`"NUMPY_OK`", numpy.__version__)' 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 1; echo STEP_DIFF; python -m pip install -q --no-input diffusers transformers accelerate safetensors 2>&1 | Select-Object -Last 1; python -c 'import diffusers; print(`"DIFFUSERS_OK`", diffusers.__version__)' 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 1; echo STEP_TORCH; python -c 'import torch; print(`"TORCH_OK`", torch.__version__, torch.cuda.is_available())' 2>&1 | Select-Object -First 1; echo STEP_PATCH; $d='C:\ShimiStudio\ShimiStudio-Local\studio'; curl.exe -s -o $d\patch15.py https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sunraz/shimi-land/main/downloads/studio15/patch15.py; python $d\patch15.py; echo DONE"
